statements.status_notes: Stack overflow in ngtcp2_qlog_parameters_set_transport_params requires the QUIC qlog callback to be enabled and a remote QUIC peer's transport parameters to be processed. cdi-importer's data sources use HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 via libcurl through nbdkit-curl; HTTP/3 is not enabled and no QUIC connections are initiated, so the qlog code path is unreachable. libngtcp2 is linked only as a transitive dependency of libcurl3t64-gnutls.
